scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd apps/data && uv sync
scripts.ready: vp fmt && vp lint && vp run test -r && vp run build -r
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,web,native,data,search -c gray,blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:db" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:native" "pnpm run dev:data" "pnpm run dev:search"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -n db,web,native,data,search -c gray,blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm run dev:db" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm --filter native run ios" "pnpm run dev:data" "pnpm run dev:search"
scripts.dev:search: cd apps/data && quickwit run 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered -E '(REST server is ready|ERROR|FATAL)'
scripts.dev:web: export DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres}; wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5432 && pnpm db:setup && vp run web#dev
scripts.dev:data: export DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres}; wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5432 && cd apps/data && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.check: pnpm exec vp check --fix && cd apps/data && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://test:test@localhost:0/test} pnpm --filter web exec vp test && cd apps/data && uv run pytest
scripts.data:clear: rm -f apps/data/ducklake.ducklake apps/data/geo_ducklake.ducklake && rm -rf apps/data/local_data apps/data/geo_local_data apps/data/qwdata apps/data/local_turfs && mkdir -p apps/data/qwdata
scripts.data:mock: cd apps/data && uv run seed-persons && uv run seed-boundaries
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:push && pnpm db:seed && pnpm db:mock
